cohort: The study included 137 women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean delivery between 2016 and 2022.
finding: The nine-step uterus-sparing cesarean section protocol significantly reduced the hysterectomy rate and severe complications compared to conventional surgery in women with PAS.
mod_finding: The nine-step uterine preservation protocol, applied during cesarean delivery, significantly reduced the hysterectomy rate and severe complications.
